subject: Stratos Insight pilot — operational KPIs, ownership, and timeline
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@stratosinsight.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@stratosinsight.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Stratos Insight pilot (post-call recap)

Thanks again for the 30-min call earlier, Elena & Tom — good alignment and great questions. Summarizing the operational plan we discussed and proposed success criteria so the procurement and engineering teams have something concrete to review. Attaching a short playbook and sample workload spec for your ops team.

High-level POC scope (30 days):
- Ingest: up to 1k sample docs (privacy-safe subset) and typical query distribution
- Core use-case: contextual query + concise extractive answers for customer support knowledge base
- Integration surface: REST API + simple web-hook for user telemetry

Proposed success KPIs (objective/measure):
- Latency: p95 inference response <= 150 ms for 256-token outputs under production-like traffic
- Throughput: sustain 100 RPS with <10% tail-latency regressions during 60s bursts
- Cost: model + infra cost per 1k tokens <= $0.80 (targeting $0.0008/token)
- Quality: human-rated helpfulness >= 92% on 100 labeled prompts (blind eval), and automated NER/precision thresholds aligned with your SLAs

Operational handoffs & owners:
- Redwood engineering (Ben): cluster sizing, warmup scripts, prefix caching behavior
- Redwood solutions (Monica): onboarding, eval templates, prompt suite
- Stratos integration (Elena): workload samples, success rubric sign-off, access to staging cluster

Next steps (actionable):
1) Elena: share sanitized sample workload and a contact for procurement (by Mon Aug 17)
2) Redwood: send final PoC playbook + cost estimate (by Tue Aug 18) — attached v1 now for review
3) Schedule tech-handoff + test account (30–45 min) the week of Aug 24 — propose Aug 25/26

If that matches what you heard, say the word and we'll lock the timeline.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments:
- stratos_poc_playbook_v1.pdf (overview, roles, measurement plan)
- sample_workload_spec.csv (schema + sample rows)
From: Elena Park <elena@stratosinsight.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@stratosinsight.com>, procurement@stratosinsight.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Stratos Insight pilot (post-call recap)

Hi Grace — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifying points from our side:
1) Latency baseline — our current system p95 is ~120ms; would you expect any cold-start degradation during the first 24 hours? Can you add an explicit warm-up step to the playbook?
2) Throughput — 100 RPS is our peak for internal pilot users; we'll supply a small stress profile (10m ramp to 100 RPS).
3) Quality metric — the 92% human-rated helpfulness sounds reasonable; can you share the evaluation template you plan to use? Also: how will you instrument sampling for blind evaluation to avoid bias?

Procurement is looped in (cc). They'll need an initial SOW + estimated monthly committed cost to move forward. Tom will coordinate the technical access.

Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform, Stratos Insight
elena@stratosinsight.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@stratosinsight.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff — Stratos Insight pilot (ops alignment and asks)

Folks — forwarding Elena's clarifying questions. Please see the two attachments she has to review (already in Drive link). Quick plan for internal alignment so we can reply with concrete answers and an updated playbook by Tue EOD.

Quick internal checklist: 
- Warm-up: add a scripted warm-up (Karthik) to run before public traffic; include cache priming and KV pre-allocation steps
- Eval template: Monica to share the blind eval sheet + sampling procedure; include instructions to withhold vendor IDs during annotation
- Cost estimate: Ben to run a conservative token-cost model for 30-day pilot + committed monthly thread; include scenario for quantized variant if needed

Proposed owner breakdown (confirm or change):
- Karthik: cluster config, warm-up runbook, perf testing scripts
- Ben: cost model & infra sizing; pricing handshake with procurement
- Monica: evaluation plan, prompt set, annotation instructions

I'll draft the reply to Elena with a short SOW stub for procurement. Can you each confirm by 3pm PT today?

—Grace
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Kickoff — Stratos Insight pilot (ops alignment and asks)

Agree with owners. Quick notes from sizing/cost:
- For target 100 RPS p95<=150ms with our default LLM-optimized runtime, baseline cluster = 4x A100 equivalents with autoscale headroom + persistent warm workers.
- Estimated infra + model serving cost (on Redwood Dedicated profile) for 30-day pilot: $12,000–$18,000 depending on quantization and caching; per-token math in attached playbook v1 shows the $0.0008/token target is achievable with mixing smaller context windows and prefix caching.
- Cold start: expect small transient p95 spikes during first 30–60 minutes after deploy; Karthik's warm-up script should bring steady-state down quickly. Include a 1-hour warm-up window in runbook.

I'll attach a concise SOW stub in my reply to Elena and add an optional discounted pilot price for a committed follow-on.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@stratosinsight.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@stratosinsight.com>, procurement@stratosinsight.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Stratos Insight pilot (ops alignment and asks)

Elena — appreciate the quick turn. Short reply and an attached SOW stub and final playbook v1 (link + attachments). Highlights:
- Warm-up: we will run a scripted 1-hour warm-up (cache priming + synthetic traffic 10->100 RPS ramp) before you put any pilot users behind it. Karthik will run this during staging window and share logs.
- Eval: Monica attached the blind eval template and sampling procedure (100 prompts; stratified by intent). Annotations will be blinded; Redwood will provide raw annotator IDs and aggregated scores only.
- Cost & SOW: Ben put the 30-day pilot estimate at $15k (midpoint) with an optional 20% pilot discount if you commit to a 6-month reserved plan before pilot completion. Procurement stubs in SOW include required PO and expected timeline.

Next logistic steps:
1) Elena/Tom: confirm availability for tech-handoff (30 min) on Aug 25 at 10:30 PT or Aug 26 at 11:00 PT
2) Elena: drop sanitized workload to the Drive link and share the staging SSH key for our team (by Mon Aug 24)
3) Procurement: if SOW looks OK, share PO template or required fields (we'll tailor the SOW)

If I don't hear back by EOD Mon we'll assume Aug 25 slot and proceed with warm-up scheduling.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting the pilot running.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
